tg_director: We measure. We do not decide what it means until we have measured enough.
That has been the rule of this building for a hundred and four years.
It is a very good rule and it is currently making me want to put my fist through a wall.
tg_migration_woman: Everything deep has come up onto the shelf. Every species, same eight weeks.
That is not food and it is not temperature. I checked both. Twice.
Animals move like that away from something. I have nothing to put in the box marked what.
tg_current_man: The Caeloran drift has run the same way since anyone wrote it down.
It has slowed nine per cent since the frost. Nine.
The Foundation funds this desk. They have asked me twice not to publish yet.
tg_intern: I get to label things. I have labelled four hundred jars this month.
The best jar is a tooth from the deep shelf that nobody can match to anything.
Director says an unmatched tooth is the most exciting object in science. She was not joking.
